committee: * Presentation of Certificate No. 350-38 (LS) - Senator Jesse Lujan
title: Buenas yan Håfa Adai! Please join me in presenting Certificate No. 350-38 (LS) – Jesse A. Lujan. Relative to recognizing the organizing committee members for their support and contributions to the successful planning of the 17th Annual “ Hågat Mango Festival”. The presentation will take place on Friday, May 22, 2025 at 6:00 P.M. at the Hågat Sagan Bisita , in Hågat . We look forward to your attendance and participation.
